MORE:
Arigato Universe Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 17/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve With reference to our prior intimation dated 04th November, 2026, we wish to inform you that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company, originally scheduled to be held on Friday, 13th November, 2026, has been postponed due to a delay in finalization of the accounts for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. Certain operational and reconciliation matters have required additional time, as a result of which the Limited Review process and the finalization of the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results could not be completed in time for consideration by the Audit Committee and the Board at the originally scheduled meeting.


The REVISED date of the Board Meeting is Tuesday, 17th November, 2026.
NEWSSUB: Board Meeting Intimation for Postponement Of Board Meeting Scheduled On Friday, 13Th November, 2026 To Tuesday, 17Th November, 2026.
